name: mrscraper
description: Search the web and read public pages as Markdown, HTML, or screenshots, and check MrScraper account usage.

interface.longDescription:
MrScraper brings live web data into your conversation. Search the web for sources, read any public page as clean Markdown or HTML, capture a screenshot, and check your MrScraper account usage. Use it to research companies, compare products, follow the news, or read documentation.

MrScraper reads a page only when you ask, works with publicly accessible pages, and does not sign in to websites. A MrScraper account and an OAuth connection are required. The plugin does not schedule recurring jobs or send notifications.
defaultPrompt: Read this page and summarize the key points.
Search the web for recent reviews of this product and compare them.
Take a screenshot of this page.
